Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Require compounds to have a canonical SMILES string and activities to have a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter target by chembl_id CHEMBL5251 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
